import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the escaped content. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Formats and sanitizes a blog entry for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The full content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully rendered HTML string with user input escaped to prevent XSS. """ # Escape any potentially dangerous characters in the user supplied strings safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Build the final HTML string using the template formatted_html = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_html
